title: Using Visual Engine Assist
description: Point your camera at the engine for instant guidance.

steps.text: Open Visual Engine Assist (More → Tools or the AI screen).
Grant camera permission, then take a photo.
AftLog identifies parts and flags visible issues.
Open manual pages or related tasks from the result.

tips: Works in the app with clear, grounded results.
Pro saves results to your history.
examples: A photo of a corroded anode to flag wear.
A picture of a cracked belt for part ID.
